description: Call this tool to read a calendar export and keep it under a name. Give path (.ics file), text (contents), or url (public .ics/webcal feed; Pro). Google, Apple, Outlook exports read. Re-importing a name replaces it.

name.description: What to call this calendar, e.g. "work" or "family"

path.description: Not available on this hosted endpoint, which has no filesystem: paste the file as text instead

url.description: Public https:// or webcal:// .ics feed. Fetched once, only because you asked; Pro feature

name: ics_import
title: Import a calendar (.ics)
